data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra now if filled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 25 at 18 leave 50, but recovery isn't guaranteed and long-run income may suffer. Other catches require recalculation; intentions aren't binding. All 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher23/18/25/17, help recruit voluntary opt-ins.
